prototype.same_subject: P23 exact subject/class/trial-stem complete triplets; two repeats train and one tests, rotating three ways
prototype.gap_sample_rule: cross predictions restricted to the exact same-subject evaluable sample_ids

skeleton.joint_order: Human3.6M-17: pelvis, right hip/knee/ankle, left hip/knee/ankle, spine, thorax, neck, head, left shoulder/elbow/wrist, right shoulder/elbow/wrist
skeleton.resampling: linear normalized-progress interpolation over all present raw frames; retain real clip duration for velocity

variants.S2_scale: S1 divided by one clip-level median of per-frame mean shoulder-width and pelvis-to-thorax length
variants.S3_facing: S2 plus one clip-level yaw rotation aligning signed shoulder/hip left-right direction
variants.S4_body_local: S2 represented in one clip-level orthonormal left-right/front/up body basis
variants.S5_relational_motion: S4 coordinates plus eight joint angles, all 136 pairwise relative distances, and 17 joint speed magnitudes

imu.source: existing aligned_multimodal/cache/imu_32 raw resampled sequence; no encoder

variants.I0_raw: five-device acc/gyro plus relative quaternion waveforms and masks
variants.I1_device_robust: per-sequence, per-device acc/gyro mean removal and IQR/MAD robust scaling; relative quaternion retained
variants.I2_magnitude: per-device acceleration magnitude, gyro magnitude, relative rotation angle and masks
variants.I3_gravity_aligned: per-device median acceleration gravity vector rotated to +Z; aligned acc/gyro plus relative rotation angle and masks
variants.I4_rotation_invariant: rotation-invariant acc/gyro/jerk/quaternion-angle waveforms plus amplitude, energy and robust distribution summaries

subject_id.purpose: measure whether subject identity remains predictable after each transformation

gate_reference.Skeleton: P23 skeleton_embedding standardized_euclidean on exact matched sample_ids
gate_reference.IMU: P23 imu_embedding standardized_euclidean on exact matched sample_ids
